coordinate_system.domain: RNA sequence index and secondary-structure pairing arcs

reference.method: exact enumeration of packaged candidate pairs plus a pseudoknot-free dynamic-programming baseline

allowed_claims: Demonstrate Digital QAOA sampling over a finite, versioned RNA candidate-pair QUBO.
Compare observed feasible pair sets with exact enumeration, a classical dynamic-programming baseline, and a separately identified reference structure.
limitations: The candidate scores are dimensionless educational model values, not thermodynamic free energies.
QAOA counts are sampling frequencies and are not base-pair probabilities or a Boltzmann ensemble.
The experiment does not predict RNA three-dimensional coordinates, solvent effects, folding rates, or biological function.
Local simulation only; no hardware execution or quantum advantage claim.
